# algebra.library: Remap

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Remaps value from the input range \[inputMin, inputMax\] onto the output range
> \[outputMin, outputMax\]. Assumes inputMin != inputMax.

## Signature

```plato
Remap(value: IReal, inputMin: IReal, inputMax: IReal, outputMin: IReal, outputMax: IReal): IReal
```

```plato
// Remapping an interval onto itself is the identity on any value in range.
Law_RemapToSelfIsIdentity(i: NumberInterval, x: Number): Boolean
    => i.Start.LawEq(i.End) || x.Remap(i, i).LawEq(x);
```

```plato

    // Remaps value from the input range [inputMin, inputMax] onto the output range
    // [outputMin, outputMax]. Assumes inputMin != inputMax.
    Remap(value: IReal, inputMin: IReal, inputMax: IReal, outputMin: IReal, outputMax: IReal): IReal
        => outputMin.Lerp(outputMax, inputMin.InverseLerp(inputMax, value));
```
